taste:
Expect a savoury breakfast built around the contrast between tender vegan sausages and crisp hash browns. The sausages give the plate its main plant-based focus, while the crunchy potatoes make it more varied to eat than toast and beans alone. An earthy roasted flat mushroom brings a distinct flavour alongside the classic baked beans and grilled tomato half.

The toast is served with smooth vegan spread, adding another texture without changing the plant-based character described for the dish. With two sausages and two hash browns, this is a hearty breakfast rather than a minimal morning bite. It suits someone who wants familiar pub breakfast components without the meat, with several separate elements to work through.
